concurrency.description: messages an instance handles at once, 1 to 64 and at most the image's maximum — absent means `1`

credentials.description: refused: a task holds credentials, an event source does not yet

delivery.description: `at-least-once`|`at-most-once`, the image's declared class — absent means `at-least-once`

env.description: mapping of strings; configuration, never a secret — absent means none

identities.description: refused: a task holds identities, an event source does not yet

input.description: constants for the Orkflow's inputs, a YAML mapping converted by the strict mapping — absent means none

match.description: list of tests, all of which must hold — absent means every message

max_bytes.description: the body bound, at most the deployment's — absent means the deployment's

name.description: the source's name, which a command naming one must agree with — absent means the command's

namespace.description: the source's namespace — absent means the command's -n

orkflow.description: slug of this namespace's Orkflow, **required**, fixed at creation

pool.description: the pool whose source hosts run the instances — absent means the namespace's default

rate.description: messages a second an instance, 1 to `event_sources.max_rate` — absent means `10`

reject_breaker.description: distinct new messages rejected in a row that pause the source; 0 disables — absent means the deployment's

resources.description: `cpu`, `memory`, per instance — absent means the pool's most

secrets.description: list of `name`, `source`, as a task's — absent means none

version.description: string — absent means the current pointer, for each message

with.description: the image's settings, a YAML mapping converted by the strict mapping, checked against the image's declared interface — absent means `{}`
